title: Jigglypuff Tunes Its Voice to Your Brain Waves
premise: Jigglypuff freely changes its voice wavelength until it matches deep-sleep brain waves.
audiencePromise: See how Jigglypuff turns a lullaby into a precise sleep mechanic, with a dangerous downside.
openLoop: Why tune its voice to sleeping brains instead of just singing?
payoff: Jigglypuff's song matches deep-sleep brain waves, but resisting it can put Jigglypuff's life at risk.
engagementQuestion: Smart sleep mechanic or dangerous song?

voice.instructions: Speak with curious urgency. Keep the pace crisp, with a small pause before each reveal. Stress the danger in the penultimate scene. Make the final choice playful but sincere.

scenes.headline: IT TUNES YOUR BRAIN
scenes.narration: Jigglypuff tunes its voice to your brain waves.
scenes.caption: NOT JUST A SOFT SONG

scenes.headline: ITS VOICE CAN SHIFT
scenes.narration: Its vocal cords can freely change the wavelength of its voice.
scenes.caption: THE WAVELENGTH IS ADJUSTABLE

scenes.headline: IT FINDS THE SLEEP SETTING
scenes.narration: It adjusts until the wavelength makes foes most drowsy.
scenes.caption: PRECISELY RIGHT FOR DROWSINESS

scenes.headline: THE PATTERNS MATCH
scenes.narration: The trick is matching sound waves with deep-sleep brain waves.
scenes.caption: SOUND WAVES MEET SLEEP WAVES

scenes.headline: RESISTING SLEEP IS RISKY
scenes.narration: If a foe resists, Jigglypuff keeps singing and risks its life.
scenes.caption: IT MAY NOT STOP SINGING

scenes.headline: SMART OR DANGEROUS?
scenes.narration: Smart sleep mechanic or dangerous song?
scenes.caption: WHICH SIDE ARE YOU ON?
